title: phyllanthus eliae
intro: Phyllanthus eliae, commonly known as the Borneo phyllanthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus eliae include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections, due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus eliae are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
